name: Star-star-delta three-winding transformer
summary: A star-star-delta transformer includes two star-connected winding sets and a delta tertiary winding.
description: A star-star-delta transformer includes two star-connected winding sets and a delta tertiary winding. The schematic needs all three winding ratings and the intended tertiary connection.
readingNotes: Trace the tertiary separately so its protection and terminal status remain visible.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A delta tertiary is a third winding, not an alternative connection of the main secondary.
